title: An empty Inactive tab says "No inactive terms"
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • This case runs on a test organization set aside for this suite, holding none of anyone else's terms, customers or log rows.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • No term is deactivated (every standard term is active and the shop has no inactive term of its own).
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the tab label shows a count of 0, and in place of the table the line "No inactive terms" shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-N2: “If the Inactive tab has no terms, it shows the line "No inactive terms" in place of the table, and its count reads 0.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Inactive tab is empty | "No inactive terms" | Inline line in place of the table”
  • S1-R3: “Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by a count of the terms in it. The page opens on Active.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab" ("A new shop: Inactive tab empty"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

  • ct-p4-03-a-new-shop-inactive-tab-empty.png

The design's own words:

  • “With nothing inactive the table shows one line: "No inactive terms".”
  • “No build shot: drawn from the rule, not checked against the build.”
